[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Cogent Communications Holdings is a publicly traded multinational internet service provider and Tier 1 network operator, listed on NASDAQ under ticker CCOI and filing with the SEC under CIK 0001158324. Cogents core business is IP transit and network connectivity delivered over its own fiber backbone, and its Phoenix, Arizona facility functions as a network point of presence and small colocation data center supporting that network business, with third-party directories placing its capacity at roughly 12 megawatts. Unlike the wholesale and hyperscale developers elsewhere in this registry, Cogents data center facilities exist primarily to support its own network operations and to offer colocation to customers who want to connect directly to Cogents IP transit service, rather than functioning as a standalone real estate leasing business. As a publicly traded, SEC-reporting company, Cogents overall corporate financials are well documented, though facility-specific capacity figures for individual sites like Phoenix are drawn from third-party data center directories rather than Cogents own public disclosures, which focus on network and financial metrics rather than site-level specifications. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.

This session made a further attempt to resolve a building specific address for this row. Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service returned 1530 E Roeser Rd, Phoenix, AZ 85040 at 0.9 confidence, in the South Mountain area of Phoenix. The operators own site lists a single Phoenix office at a different address, 3410 E University Dr Suite 350, Phoenix, AZ 85034, described as an office rather than a data center, on a different street and in a different postal code from the geocoded coordinates, with nothing on that page confirming it is the same site as this rows stored coordinates. A dedicated aggregator listing for this exact facility, a Wikipedia search for a Phoenix facility, and a datacentermap.com area listing all failed to load or found no match. Given no second, independent source corroborates the geocoded coordinates address, and the operators own listed Phoenix address does not obviously refer to the same building, no address is applied to this row, consistent with this projects standard that a geocoding services own confidence score is not itself external corroboration.
